# CompositeMode

`Flare.Components.CompositeMode`

How a composite column (FlareColumn with a Composite) lays out its fields.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Banded` | `0` | Each record spans several real table rows; fields align across the whole table (DevExpress banded-view style). This is the default. |
| `Card` | `1` | All fields are stacked inside a single cell as a CSS grid (a card per record). |

## Used by components

- `FlareColumn`
